scope: Proposition 6.5 (Uniform early continuation) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-with-local-conservation-for-the-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640850bc08703544), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix δ > 0 and ζ ∈ (0, 1). There are s̄0 > 0 and T0 ∈ (0, t1), depending on δ and ζ and on the fixed jet parameters, such that for every 0 < s0 ≤ s̄0, every finite approximation, and every 0 < T ≤ T0, the dormant solution and every solution selected in Proposition 6.3 continue to t1 and satisfy sup 0≤t≤t1 ∥h(t)∥H ≤ ζ. (6.12) The choices are uniform in N, the collision cutoff, Rµ, and T. For dormant solutions, (6.7) also holds on an initial interval independent of these indices, with the fixed exponent A > p + 1 chosen in (6.5).
